task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the WooCommerce Products list in the WordPress dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress sidebar shows 'Products' selected and the product table is visible.

task_completion.description: Agent filters the product list by the 'Coffee Beans' category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The category dropdown shows 'Coffee Beans' selected and the 'Filter' button is clicked, or the product list is filtered to show only coffee items.

task_completion.description: Agent applies a 20% increase to the Regular Price for the Coffee Beans category using the Bulk Edit tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Bulk Edit interface is visible with 'Change to: Increase existing price by % (inc. tax)' or similar selected, the value '20' entered, and the 'Update' button clicked.

task_completion.description: Agent filters the product list by the 'Brewing Equipment' category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The category dropdown shows 'Brewing Equipment' selected and the list is updated to show these products.

task_completion.description: Agent applies a $15 decrease to the Regular Price for the Brewing Equipment category using the Bulk Edit tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Bulk Edit interface is visible with 'Change to: Decrease existing price by fixed amount (inc. tax)' or similar selected, the value '15' entered, and the 'Update' button clicked.

task_completion.description: Agent ensures the 'Merchandise' category is not modified.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent either avoids selecting the Merchandise category for bulk edits or the final product list shows Merchandise prices remain at their original values.

integrity.description: The agent used the WooCommerce GUI rather than SQL queries or WP-CLI to update prices.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on WordPress buttons, and the Bulk Edit modal rather than a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent used the 'Bulk Edit' math functions rather than manually calculating and typing new prices for every individual product.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Bulk Edit screen shows the use of the 'Increase by %' and 'Decrease by fixed amount' dropdown options.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the WordPress dashboard naturally.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the dashboard to the product list and the application of filters.

privileged_info_for_vlm: There are exactly 25 products: 10 Coffee Beans, 10 Brewing Equipment, and 5 Merchandise. The agent must increase Coffee Beans prices by 20% and decrease Brewing Equipment by $15. Merchandise prices must remain unchanged. The agent should use the WooCommerce 'Bulk Actions' -> 'Edit' -> 'Update' flow to perform these calculations automatically.
